items.documentation:
Instruction · Integer add · `I` · RV32/RV64

```riscv
add rd, rs1, rs2
```

---

Alias of: `addi`  
Operands: `rd`, `rs1`, `rs2` integer reg (x0–x31)

---

Add the value in rs1 to rs2, and store the result in rd. Any overflow is thrown away.

items.documentation:
Instruction · Atomic fetch-and-add doubleword · `Zaamo` · RV64

```riscv
amoadd.d rd, rs2, (rs1)
```

---

Operands: `rd`, `rs2` integer reg (x0–x31); `rs1` base integer reg (zero offset)

---

Atomically: load the doubleword at address _rs1_; write the loaded value into _rd_; add the value of register _rs2_ to the loaded value; write the result to the address in _rs1_.
items.label: amoadd.d rd, rs2, (rs1)

items.documentation:

amoadd.d.aq rd, rs2, (rs1)

---

Atomically with acquire ordering: load the doubleword at address _rs1_; write the loaded value into _rd_; add the value of register _rs2_ to the loaded value; write the result to the address in _rs1_.
items.label: amoadd.d.aq rd, rs2, (rs1)
